description: This file contains utility functions and templates for tensor reduction operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including bounds calculations, tensor reshaping, reduction setup, and reduction result handling.

methods.name: upper_bound
methods.description: Returns the maximum representable value for a scalar type, including infinity if available.

methods.name: lower_bound
methods.description: Returns the minimum representable value for a scalar type, including negative infinity if available.

methods.name: restride_dim
methods.description: Returns a tensor with a specified dimension re-strided to have stride zero, using a new shape.

methods.name: _dimreduce_setup
methods.description: Prepares the result tensor for a reduction operation by resizing it to match the input tensor with the specified dimension reduced to size 1.

methods.name: _dimreduce_return_trivial
methods.description: Handles trivial reduction cases where the input tensor has a single element or is empty, setting the result accordingly.

methods.name: _dimreduce_return_trivial_no_ident
methods.description: Handles trivial reduction cases without an identity value, setting the result tensor.

methods.name: _allreduce_return_trivial
methods.description: Returns a tensor with the identity value if the input tensor is empty, otherwise nullopt.

methods.name: check_scalar_type_device_layout_equal
methods.description: Checks that two tensors have the same scalar type, device, and layout.

methods.name: integer_upcast
methods.description: Upcasts a tensor to a larger integer type if necessary, based on optional dtype.

methods.name: make_dim_vector
methods.description: Creates a dimension vector from optional dims or defaults to all dimensions.

methods.name: make_dim_mask
methods.description: Creates a bitmask for dimensions based on optional dims.

methods.name: shape_from_dim_mask
methods.description: Generates a shape vector from a tensor's size and a dimension mask, adjusting for keepdim.

methods.name: resize_reduction_result
methods.description: Resizes the result tensor for a reduction operation based on input tensor shape and mask.

methods.name: create_reduction_result
methods.description: Creates an output tensor for reduction with the appropriate shape and dtype.

methods.name: review_reduce_result
methods.description: Adjusts the shape and stride of a reduction result tensor based on keepdim.

methods.name: make_reduction
methods.description: Constructs a TensorIterator for reduction operations, handling dtype promotion and dimension masking.

methods.name: make_reduction_from_out_ty
methods.description: Creates a reduction TensorIterator with output type considerations for mixed precision.

methods.name: zero_numel_check_dims
methods.description: Checks that the reduction dimension is valid for a tensor with zero elements.

methods.name: zero_numel_tensor_resize
methods.description: Resizes output tensors for zero-element tensors based on reduction dims and keepdim.

methods.name: get_dtype_from_self
methods.description: Determines the appropriate dtype for a tensor, optionally promoting integers.

methods.name: get_dtype_from_result
methods.description: Gets the dtype from a result tensor or specified dtype.

methods.name: get_reduction_shape
methods.description: Computes the shape of the tensor after reduction over specified dims.

methods.name: resize_reduction
methods.description: Resizes the output tensor for reduction based on input tensor and dims.

methods.name: resize_reduction_with_indices
methods.description: Resizes output tensors for reduction with indices.
